artifact.summary: Abstained. The specification contains only upper bounds on the number of controlled unitaries (4d_A-5, 2d_A-1, and the n-partite product bound). It gives no explicit decomposition, no ordering or control roles, and no gate parameters. Any circuit would be an invented construction rather than a reconstruction, so no code is produced.

equation_mapping.explanation: This is a counting bound for bipartite unitaries (at most 4d_A-5 controlled unitaries). It does not define an operation, so it cannot be built as a circuit without the paper's construction.
This is the reduced counting bound (2d_A-1) when d_A is a power of two. It is a length bound only, and no gate sequence is given.
This is the n-partite counting bound. It needs the unstated construction, with each gate controlled from n-1 systems, and the qudit dimensions generally do not map to qubits.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to no implementation: the bounds are treated as background or out-of-scope facts, not as circuit-defining equations.
specification_changes.reason: The equations bound gate counts and do not specify the unitaries, control structure, ordering, or angles of any explicit circuit.

assumptions: Implementing an arbitrary or random decomposition would not preserve the meaning of the source result, so none was attempted.
unresolved_issues: The explicit decomposition of an arbitrary d_A x d_B unitary into controlled unitaries is not given.
The order and control roles of the individual controlled unitaries are not specified.
The qubit encoding for non-power-of-two dimensions is not specified.
The CNOT/entanglement cost bounds in terms of Schmidt rank and the nonnegative-rank link to the log-rank conjecture are not given as equations.
No public validation contract or requested instance was supplied.
